title: Fix chapter export download + actionable error messages

requirements.summary: Make chapter export (PDF/DOCX) reliably download a file from the chapter editor and replace generic failures with actionable English error messages while preventing duplicate export requests.
acceptanceCriteria: From the chapter edit view, clicking “Export PDF” downloads a .pdf file for an empty chapter and for a chapter with content.
From the chapter edit view, clicking “Export DOCX” downloads a .docx file for an empty chapter and for a chapter with content.
The export UI indicates exporting state and prevents repeated clicks while an export is in progress (no duplicate requests).
If export fails, the toast/error message shown to the user is in English and includes a short reason derived from the thrown error (while still being safe to display).
The downloaded files have sanitized filenames based on the chapter title (as currently implemented via sanitizeFilename).

file_operations.description: Add a small utility to derive a short, safe-to-display English reason string from unknown thrown errors (e.g., Error.message, serialized values, and common agent/canister error patterns), with length limits and fallback text.

Update the export handlers to (1) allow exporting even when the chapter content is empty (remove the current early-return that blocks empty exports), (2) set and honor a single exporting guard at the very start of the export flow (including any auto-save) to prevent duplicate clicks/requests, (3) on success, always trigger browser download using downloadFile with the correct MIME type and sanitized filenames via sanitizeFilename, and (4) on failure (including null/empty backend response), show an English toast like "Export failed: <reason>" where <reason> comes from the new exportError utility instead of the current generic/localized message.
